g.text: Gemma net configuration LoC per month · branch phase2-acl-migrate · symlog scale

Source: `git log phase2-acl-migrate --numstat --no-merges`. bucketed by calendar month (256 buckets). config = .xml/.yml/.json/.properties/.toml + Dockerfile/Makefile. excludes target/, node_modules/, build/, dist/, *.min.js, lockfiles. y-axis symlog (linthresh=1000) so the renovation month doesn't crush historical bars. renovations marker at 2026-05-16.
